description: This file defines API endpoints for managing recipes, including listing, retrieving, creating, updating, deleting, and favoriting recipes, using FastAPI framework. It includes route handlers, filters, and dependency injections for database access and user authentication.

methods.name: _apply_filters( query, q: Optional[str] = None, title: Optional[str] = None, ingredient: Optional[str] = None, author_id: Optional[int] = None, )
methods.description: Applies filtering criteria to a SQLAlchemy Recipe query based on optional search parameters.

methods.name: list_recipes( db: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db)], q: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Search text across title and ingredients"), title: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by title (contains)"), ingredient: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by ingredient (contains)"), author_id: Optional[int] = Query(None, description="Filter by author id"), skip: int = Query(0, ge=0, description="Number of records to skip"), limit: int = Query(20, ge=1, le=100, description="Max records to return"), )
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated, optionally filtered list of recipes.

methods.name: get_recipe(recipe_id: int, db: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db)])
methods.description: Fetches details of a single recipe by its ID.

methods.name: create_recipe( payload: RecipeCreate, db: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db)], current_user: Annotated[User, Depends(get_current_user)], )
methods.description: Creates a new recipe linked to the current authenticated user.

methods.name: update_recipe( recipe_id: int, payload: RecipeUpdate, db: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db)], current_user: Annotated[User, Depends(get_current_user)], )
methods.description: Updates an existing recipe if the current user is the owner.

methods.name: delete_recipe( recipe_id: int, db: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db)], current_user: Annotated[User, Depends(get_current_user)], )
methods.description: Deletes a recipe if the current user is the owner.

methods.name: favorite_recipe( recipe_id: int, db: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db)], current_user: Annotated[User, Depends(get_current_user)], )
methods.description: Marks a recipe as a favorite for the current user, ensuring idempotency.

methods.name: unfavorite_recipe( recipe_id: int, db: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db)], current_user: Annotated[User, Depends(get_current_user)], )
methods.description: Removes the favorite mark from a recipe for the current user.

methods.name: list_my_favorites( db: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db)], current_user: Annotated[User, Depends(get_current_user)], skip: int = Query(0, ge=0, description="Number of records to skip"), limit: int = Query(20, ge=1, le=100, description="Max records to return"), )
methods.description: Lists all recipes favorited by the current user.

methods.name: list_favorites_for_recipe( recipe_id: int, db: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db)], )
methods.description: Lists all users who have favorited a particular recipe.
